requirement.description: The RLP encoding implementation has several issues with handling different data types correctly, particularly with string encoding and handling of edge cases. Many tests fail due to incorrect encoding/decoding logic and missing validation.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_encode function to properly encode integers, strings, and lists according to RLP specification. Ensure that the encoding handles edge cases correctly (like empty strings, single-byte strings, etc.) and produces the expected hex encodings. The function should also properly handle str_mode='hex' for hex strings.

requirement.description: The cryptographic functions (private_key_to_public_key, private_key_to_address, sign_message_hash, get_signer_public_key) require external dependencies (ecdsa, hashlib) that are not installed in the environment. Tests fail with ImportError when trying to use these functions.
requirement.contract: Ensure that the cryptographic functions properly handle missing dependencies by providing clear error messages when ecdsa or hashlib are not available. The functions should work correctly when dependencies are installed.

requirement.description: The rlp_decode function lacks proper handling of various input types and doesn't support all expected decoding modes (ascii, raw_hex, prefix_hex). The function often fails to parse hex strings correctly.
requirement.contract: Improve the rlp_decode function to properly handle different input types and decoding modes. It should correctly decode RLP-encoded data into the expected format based on the types parameter.

requirement.description: Some functions like rlp_encode_address_nonce_tuple are not exposed at the module level, causing import errors in tests.
requirement.contract: Expose all required functions at the module level in the __init__.py file and ensure they are callable from the binary module namespace.

requirement.description: Missing implementation for some helper functions like rlp_encode_address_nonce_tuple that are called by tests but not implemented.
requirement.contract: Implement the missing rlp_encode_address_nonce_tuple function to properly encode address-nonce pairs according to RLP specification.
